results.title: Brigham nurses reach tentative contract deal, averting open-ended strike
results.description: The tentative agreement means nurses will report to work as usual Thursday instead of picketing. Hospital officials will not use the hundreds of temporary workers they had hired and begun training to keep the hospital open during the strike.

results.title: Ohio jobs: Tens of thousands Ohioans exit labor force, as residents age, get discouraged
results.description: Ohio’s labor force participation rate, like the state’s unemployment rate, recently fell to historic lows, and tens of thousands of Ohioans exited the labor market in the last year, according to survey data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
